system.effect:
Humans notice you more than other spiders. The Difficulty to be spotted by humans is reduced by 1 at all times.

A documented phenomenon.

Once per heist, the ST may make you volunteer for something you shouldn't have, because you said you could handle it. Spend 1 SP to delay it a round — you still do it.

You've handled worse. (You haven't handled this.)

Operationally loud. At Alert 5+, all your Stealth rolls have their Difficulty increased by 1.

Not physically loud. Operationally loud. Things break near you.

You cannot simply do a thing. Once per heist, the ST may require your action to involve unnecessary spectacle, raising the Alert by 1. Spend 1 SP to delay one round; it still fires.

Everything is an event. You know. You can't stop.

You'll sneeze at a bad moment at least once per heist — the ST picks when. When you do, make a Stealth roll (Difficulty 3) or the Alert rises by 1. Either way, everyone in earshot knows something happened.

Once per heist, the ST may freeze your action for a round while you insist on revising the plan. If the crew acts anyway during that round, you lose 1 SP from the stress. Spend 1 SP to delay the trigger a round — the freeze still happens.

You must revise the plan, ideally right now, ideally out loud.

Once per heist, at a moment of the ST's choosing while you're holding an item or the loot, you lose your grip. It lands in a random adjacent square. Someone must use an Action to recover it before moving on. You earn 1 SP for the trouble.

You will drop the thing. The important thing. At the important moment.

Vacuums cause immediate panic. When one activates in your scene, make a NERVE roll (Difficulty 3) or lose your action.

Vacuums cause immediate, total panic.
Shiny objects, interesting smells, and fascinating details derail you. Once per heist, the ST can delay your action by one round.

Once per heist, the ST may require the Difficulty 4 version of a roll instead of the standard, because you chose the flashier approach. On a Critical, earn 1 SP — the crowd appreciated it. Spend 1 SP to delay the trigger one round.

You'll take the flashier, harder approach. Sometimes it even works.
